editorial.blurb: Mia Francesca is a warmly welcoming Italian standout where fresh, flavorful pastas and thoughtful service create the kind of dining experience you'll crave again before leaving.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the rigatoni vodka with crumbled sausage and ricotta, and always finish with the pistachio profiteroles—they're a signature highlight worth requesting even if you're tempted by other desserts.
signatureDishes: Rigatoni vodka with crumbled sausage and ricotta
